message: `aria-busy="true"` on the part sets the live region of `error` otherwise than its role does
$reason: An error part with its `alert` and `aria-busy="true"` beside it. Both engines tell a reader the region is busy (measured on 2026-10-27: Chromium 153 `busy`, Firefox 158 `container-busy="true"` and the busy state), Chromium fires no change of a busy region and NVDA drops every event of one: a message that changes while shown, `Required` to `Too short`, is announced by neither. Point 7 read the part's role and politeness and what may hide it, and passed it.
